Population increased in Basildon

The estimated population of Basildon in 2024 was 193,632 usual residents, a rise of 1.3% since 2023.

This meant that Basildon's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Basildon increased by 3.2%.

Over this slightly longer period, Basildon was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Basildon

The average (median) age fell to 38.8 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Basildon has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Basildon is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Basildon's population of 193,632 usual residents was made up of:

  • 40,547 people aged 0 to 15 years, (20.9%)
  • 120,045 people aged 16 to 64 years, (62%)
  • 33,040 people aged 65 years and over, (17.1%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Basildon has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 0 to 15 years (20.9% compared with 18.3% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Basildon, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Basildon
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Basildon, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 673 people (0.4%). In total, there were 2,165 births and 1,492 deaths in Basildon.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 69 (0%). There were 10,254 people entering the area and 10,185 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Basildon's population of 1,768 (0.9%) as a result of 2,361 people entering the area and 593 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Basildon was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Basildon in mid-2023 is 191,120.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 722 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 146 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 576 people.
